assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heartbeats, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
To characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, a 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated.
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study was performed.
The CPT code for the study is 93226.
The study was medically necessary to address the specific clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
